title: Playbook
description: A curated collection of plays organized into sections. Sections are hybrid: 'formation_sections' are explicit play-id lists (the coach-authored spine of the playbook); 'situational_sections' are tag-driven views over the play library (3rd-and-short, goal-line, two-minute, etc.). The 'audience' field is documentation only — level-of-play appropriateness (HS / college / NFL / youth) is enforced by the validation MCP, not by this schema.

then.$comment: global mode: the top-level audibles pool is required.
per-formation mode: every formation_section must define its own audibles.

play_entry_role.description: Structural relationship of this play to the rest of the playbook. 'base' = core call you live on. 'counter' = punishes over-pursuit of a base call. 'constraint' = constrains a defensive tendency (alignment, key, leverage). 'complement' = pairs with a base call (e.g. PA off the run game, screen off a drop-back package). 'misdirection' = primary mechanism is deception (reverse, naked boot, fake reverse). 'answer' = beats a specific defensive look (cover-0 beater, blitz beater, fire-zone beater). 'opener' = scripted first-15 / early-script call used to feel out the defense. 'package' = designed as part of a multi-play option series (triple option tree, RPO tree). 'tempo' = primary purpose is no-huddle / catch-the-defense pace. 'trick' = gadget / fake / one-time special (Statue of Liberty, fake punt, halfback pass). Distinct from call frequency, which is captured by expected_calls_per_game / call_share_pct.

play_entry_install_order.description: When this play gets taught during the install calendar. 'install-day-1' = first day of camp / first install meeting. 'mid-season-add' = added during the season as a game-plan answer.

min.description: Lower bound of expected calls in a typical game.

max.description: Upper bound of expected calls in a typical game.

play_entry_calls_per_game.description: Expected call count per game. Most natural for coaches scripting a game plan ('I want this called 6-10 times tonight'). At least one of min/max must be present; provide both for a range.

play_entry_practice_reps.description: How often this play gets reps in practice once installed. 'every-period' = full reps every practice. 'weekly-team' = a team period every week. 'game-week-only' = repped only the week of a game it's been game-planned into. 'showcase' = installed once, then walked through before games when called for.

play_id.description: Must match a play_id from data/plays/. Cross-reference validation is performed by the validation MCP, not the schema.

share_of_section_pct.description: Share of THIS SECTION'S snaps that this play represents, as a percentage (0-100). To get the play's share of total offensive snaps, multiply by the section's target_snap_share_pct. Within a section, all plays' share_of_section_pct should sum to ~100 — the validation MCP flags significant deviations.

notes.description: Playbook-specific coaching note for this play (e.g. 'our base 1st-down call vs 4-3'). Distinct from the play YAML's own notes.

tags.description: Playbook-local tags that don't belong on the play itself (e.g. 'qb-friendly', 'red-zone-only').

counter_responses.description: How this play responds to specific defensive counters. Each entry pairs a defensive_counter (referenced by id from the play's defensive_counters list) with the offensive response — an audible to one of the 5 playbook audibles, optionally with hot routes. Exactly one entry should be marked priority: primary (the best answer); the rest are alternatives if the primary is itself defended.

slot.description: Audible slot number (1-based). Each slot must be unique within its audibles array, and slots should run contiguously from 1. The number of slots is not fixed by the schema — it is a per-playbook (and ultimately per-game) choice.

play_id.description: The play this audible slot checks to. Must reference a real play in data/plays/ and should be one of the plays already in the playbook's formation_sections.

call_name.description: The actual word/phrase the QB shouts at the LOS to trigger this audible (e.g. 'RED 22', 'OMAHA', 'KILL KILL'). Optional but recommended.

notes.description: Coaching note on when this audible gets used in general.

player.description: Player label (e.g. 'Z', 'TE', 'HB') whose route gets changed.

new_route.description: Route id (matches a file in data/routes/) to replace the player's assigned route with.

counter_ref.description: References a counter_id from the play's defensive_counters array (data/plays/<play_id>.yaml). The validation MCP checks that this id resolves.

priority.description: Which response this is. Exactly one counter_response per play should be 'primary' — the best answer. Others are secondary/tertiary alternatives if the primary is itself defended.

audible_slot.description: Which audible to check to, by slot number. In 'global' audible_mode this references a slot in the playbook's top-level audibles array. In 'per-formation' mode it references a slot in the audibles array of the formation_section this play belongs to.

hot_routes.description: Optional pre-snap route changes layered on top of the audible play. The audible play stays the same; specific receivers get a different route.

notes.description: Coaching note explaining why this audible+hot-routes combination beats the defensive counter.

any_of.description: A play matches if it has ANY of these tags.

all_of.description: A play matches only if it has ALL of these tags.

none_of.description: A play is excluded if it has ANY of these tags.

tag_filter.description: Tag-based filter for situational sections. At least one of any_of/all_of must be present.

name.description: Human-readable name, e.g. 'High School Base Playbook'.

description.description: 1-3 sentences: what this playbook is for, what offense it represents, what level / style it targets.

audience.description: Target level of play. Documentation only — does NOT gate which plays may be included. Use the validation MCP to check level-appropriateness of individual plays.

philosophy.description: Anchoring philosophy (e.g. 'power-run', 'spread-power', 'west-coast', 'pro-style'). Should match a philosophy_ref used by the plays inside.

season.description: Free-form season label, e.g. '2026', 'Spring 2026 install', 'Week 5 game plan vs East High'.

version.description: SemVer string for tracking playbook revisions.

audible_mode.description: Which audible model this playbook uses. 'global' = one playbook-wide pool of audibles (the top-level `audibles` array); every play's counter_responses checks into that one pool. 'per-formation' = each formation_section defines its own `audibles` array; a play's counter_responses checks into the pool of its own section (this mirrors games like Madden 2014 that scope audibles per formation). The model is a per-playbook choice; ultimately a target game's profile may constrain which models are legal, but the schema permits either.

audibles.description: The playbook-wide audible pool. Used (and required) when audible_mode is 'global'. Ignored when audible_mode is 'per-formation' (each formation_section carries its own audibles instead). Slots must be unique and run contiguously from 1; the count is a per-playbook choice, not fixed by the schema. play_ids should already appear in formation_sections.plays — a play used as an audible should be one you've installed.

formation_sections.description: Explicit play-list sections. Each section is anchored to one or more formations and contains a curated, ordered list of plays. This is the coach-authored spine of the playbook.

section_id.description: Stable identifier for the section, e.g. 'i-formation-base'.

description.description: 1-2 sentences explaining the section's role in the playbook.

formations.description: Formation IDs this section covers. Most sections will list one (e.g. ['i-formation']); a 'Shotgun' section may list several (e.g. ['shotgun-2x2', 'shotgun-trips-left', 'shotgun-trips-right']). The validation MCP checks that every play in the section uses a formation in this list.

target_snap_share_pct.description: Share of total offensive snaps this section is targeted to get, as a percentage (0-100). 'We want to be a 40% I-Formation team' → 40. Across all formation_sections, target_snap_share_pct should sum to ~100 (allowing a small residual for situational packages). The validation MCP flags significant deviations.

formation_usage_split.description: Optional breakdown when a section covers multiple formations. Map of formation_id → percentage (0-100) of THIS SECTION's snaps that go to each formation. Values should sum to ~100. Example for a Shotgun section: { shotgun-2x2: 60, shotgun-trips-left: 20, shotgun-trips-right: 20 }. Omit when the section has a single formation.

audibles.description: This section's audible pool. Used (and required) only when the playbook's audible_mode is 'per-formation'. The plays in this section reference these slots in their counter_responses. Slots must be unique and run contiguously from 1. Ignored when audible_mode is 'global'.

plays.description: Ordered list of plays in this section. Convention: ordered by call frequency (highest share_of_section_pct first). When share is tied, fall back to install_order (earliest first). Install order is captured by the play_entry.install_order field, not by YAML position. Display tools (PDFs, call sheets) should respect this ordering.

min_plays.description: Optional minimum-play target for this section (e.g. 'I-Formation must have at least 6 runs'). The validation MCP can report sections that fall short.

notes.description: Coach-level notes about the section as a whole.

situational_sections.description: Tag-driven views over the play inventory. Used for situational call lists (3rd-and-short, goal-line, two-minute) that cross formation boundaries.

explicit_includes.description: Play IDs to add to the view on top of the tag filter. Use when a play belongs here but doesn't have the right tag and you don't want to retag it.

explicit_excludes.description: Play IDs to remove from the tag-filtered view (e.g. a play that has the 'goal-line' tag but isn't in this particular playbook's goal-line package).

scope.description: 'playbook-only' = the view is restricted to plays appearing in formation_sections of this playbook. 'whole-library' = the view can pull any play in data/plays/. Default 'playbook-only' is the coach-sane choice.

tags.description: Free-form tags about the playbook itself, e.g. ['power-run', 'install-friendly', 'first-year-program'].

notes.description: Free-form coach notes about the playbook as a whole.
